hits.title: COMMITTEE ON APPROPRIATIONS (AUGUST 17, 2026)
hits.topic: Negros Island regional offices, plantilla positions, and funding

moments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Chedeng Alvarez
moments.said: Alvarez said he was one of the principal authors of Republic Act 12,000, which created the Negros Island region and was signed in June 2024. More than two years later, residents of Negros Occidental, Negros Oriental, and Siquijor were awaiting a fully functional and funded regional structure.

moments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Chedeng Alvarez
moments.said: He asked whether the agencies already had offices in the Negros Island region or were still relying on LGU facilities, and whether they had vehicles and complete staffs. He asked why regional offices and plantilla positions remained at varying stages of evaluation, finalization, and approval, and why some proposed 2027 budgets had reportedly been reduced.

moments.speaker: DBM Secretary Kim De Leon
moments.said: De Leon said DBM had given higher priority to agency proposals supporting the establishment of Negros Island regional offices. DBM prioritized basic operating needs such as office setup or rent, vehicles, and necessary office equipment, and said the 2027 regional allocation for Negros Island was higher than allocations for other regions.

moments.speaker: DBM Secretary Kim De Leon
moments.said: De Leon reported that, as of 07/28/2026, 30 national government agencies had approved plantilla positions and offices for their Negros Island regional offices. DBM had also received requests from an additional eight agencies that it was evaluating.

moments.speaker: BLGF executive director
moments.said: The BLGF official said the agency was considering a satellite office in Dumaguete City because of the distance between the proposed main office in Negros Occidental and Negros Oriental and Siquijor.

moments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Chedeng Alvarez
moments.said: Alvarez corrected the description of the geography, saying Negros Island was one main island and that Siquijor was about twenty minutes away. He welcomed the possible satellite office and invited departments to visit the region and consult their staff about operational needs.

moments.speaker: BLGF executive director
moments.said: The BLGF official said the agency had recently visited the Negros Island region and had discussed the issue with the mayor of Dumaguete City. The mayor was willing to provide free space for a BLGF satellite office, and the agency was considering that option.
